mapper.insert: INSERT INTO article(game_id, title, type, content, created_at) VALUES(#{gameId}, #{title}, #{type}, #{content}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.game_id, a.title, a.type, a.content, COUNT(c.id) AS chunkCount, CASE WHEN COUNT(c.id) > 0 AND MAX(c.embedding) IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS vectorized FROM article a LEFT JOIN chunk c ON c.article_id = a.id WHERE a.game_id = #{gameId} GROUP BY a.id, a.game_id, a.title, a.type, a.content ORDER BY a.id DESC
